speaker: Doctor
text: The acute onset of right leg weakness and falls over one week contrasts with your six-month history of cognitive decline and paranoia. To distinguish between a structural cause like a brain tumor or stroke and a neurodegenerative process, I need to see the brain. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI of the brain with contrast.

text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML). The patient is severely immunocompromised with a CD4 count of 56/μL, and the MRI findings of non-enhancing white matter lesions (implied by the progression and typical presentation in this context, though the previous turn mentioned ring-enhancing lesions which can be atypical or concurrent with opportunistic infections like toxoplasmosis or TB, PML is the primary concern given the profound immunosuppression and specific neurocognitive decline pattern). However, given the explicit "ring-enhancing" description in the previous turn and the HIV status, Cerebral Toxoplasmosis remains a strong differential. I will request Toxoplasma IgG and HIV Viral Load to confirm the etiology and guide treatment.
